name: DeepSearchQA
description: DeepSearchQA is a benchmark for evaluating deep search and question-answering capabilities, testing models' ability to perform multi-hop reasoning and information retrieval across complex knowledge domains.
reputation: A very recent agent benchmark from the DeepSearchQA paper, with limited evidence of broad community adoption so far.
notes: Recent benchmark with likely limited public leaderboard history; task success can vary substantially with tool use, retrieval setup, and prompting.
